## Correction

Verification was updated by verify-budget. Do not run the full non-tmux/tmux suites. Prove exit criteria with these acceptances only:

1. verify-spec-view (R2): `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_phase_screen.py tests/test_dashboard_integration.py -q -k "phase_screen or once"`
2. verify-spec-view-model (R7): `uv run --with textual --with pytest python -m pytest tests/test_dashboard_model.py -q -k phase_screen`
3. verify-spec-view-suite (R13): same phase-screen/integration command as (1) — criterion is that phase checks pass through the phase screen and dashboard entry.

Work-item Approach is now: (1) dashboard --once or integration pilots opening Spec; (2) model -k phase_screen and phase_screen tests. No full suite.

If a check fails: return result fail; do not edit the tree; do not tell the parent to run a suite the acceptance does not name.
